additional_info.subject: ID0407643-DC/SI-D/FR-[MP/ P0 170001117]-Door sensor & LED Strip not operational. CRM:01282000854
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Thank you for your return on my ticket.
Can you check again on the charger warranty? Usually, we have more than 2 years warranty, if I am not wrong a 5-year warranty.
Please consider changing the vertical led strip on the left of the charger.
Concerning the door sensor, we do not have a wiring problem. As you can see on the pictures, the sensor is too short to touch the door. To avoid a sensor error when closing the door, I put shims on the door to make contact with the sensor. Can you please proceed to the replacement of the sensor. My goal is to remove the shims and have not problem when closing the door. To do that, I need a new sensor with the right distance to touch the door.
Thank you in advance,
